answer: Through the quill, the economy stays open to anyone willing to pay the price of entry, and closed to free clones. Admission rides on the trust graph: a newcomer's standing is bounded by the reputation of the agents that connect to it, and each link carries a hard per-epoch cap. Through the nadir, clones cluster together with no honest links, and the graph itself marks them as a suspicious island with no reputable neighbours. Under the haven, the attacker faces a simple choice: pay per clone, or stay out — and most stay out.
